title: Tail Vein Injection Protocol for Mice
author: Jason Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x5dfq26

steps.title: Induce Vasodilation
steps.instruction: Place mice in clean cages and keep them warm under a heat lamp for approximately 5 minutes with constant monitoring to induce vasodilation.

steps.title: Restrain Mouse
steps.instruction: Transfer the mice into a restrainer that features a hole for the tail.

steps.title: Prepare Tail for Injection
steps.instruction: Clean the tail using 70% Ethanol wipes and rotate the tail 45º to make the tail vein visible.

steps.title: Administer Injectate
steps.instruction: Introduce a 27G syringe into the tail vein to administer the injectate.

substeps.instruction: Use a U-100 insulin syringe for precise volume introduction to avoid dead volumes.

steps.title: Prevent Backflow
steps.instruction: Apply light pressure over the injection site for approximately 30 seconds to prevent backflow.

steps.title: Post-Injection Monitoring
steps.instruction: Return mice to housing cages and monitor them for the next several days for any evidence of swelling or complications at the injection site.
